name: Gandii Baat
overview: Unraveling complexed relationships, closet issues, shocking truths, bizarre myths and unexplored space of men and women through a series of thrilling and exciting stories from the rural part of India. Each story is distinct from other but weaved with the thread of eccentricities which will leave you with unexpected twists and turns.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Relationships over time, have become complicated or maybe they were never that simple as they seem. Gandii Baat unravels such complexed relationships, closet issues, shocking truths, bizarre myths and unexplored space of men and women through a series of thrilling and fascinating stories from the rural part of India. Each story is distinct from other but weaved with the thread of eccentricities which will leave you with unexpected twists and turns. In these stories you will see how people from rural India are deeply affected by their dark fantasies. And it's not just men, but even rural women going to any extent for the sake of sex - including heinous crimes as well! This is a show which will make your heart throb a lot faster.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Demanding and forthright are not the traits women expect from rural women. Season 2 is a collection of stories which reveals the sexually bold and unapologetic side of women from the villages of India. This time, women are willing to explore and embrace their darkest desires, they get deeply involved in unspeakable dirty deeds. The things they are willing to do for turning every situation in their favour will leave you shocked!

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Spice up your life. Experience some fun! When love and lust meet on Gandii Baat 3, they stir up sexual preferences and equations that are taboo, weird, exciting, and crazy, yet progressive at the same time in today's ever-changing society. This season showcases different preferences of people in terms of sexual partners, but also the crazy places where they choose to get down, hot & steamy. It explores sensually thrilling stories across a train, bus, boat, airport and more of rural people’s experience of urban India.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: With every new episode, it'll make you crave for more and keep you hooked to your screen. These brand new and hottest chapters of Gandii Baat 4 clubs love and passion in a never-seen-before way. Are you ready to be mindblown by Gandii Baat 4's bold urban and rural drama?

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: This time around, it is bigger and bolder than the previous seasons as it draws attention with its youth-centric plot. Gandi Baat 5 seamlessly portrays the ground reality that revolves around social stigma, loneliness, sexuality, peer pressure, and companionship that will connect with the viewers on a large scale. So, are you ready to catch ALTBalaji’s Gandii Baat 5?

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Gandii Baat 6 is a brand-new season that is ready to take on the world once again with its intriguing and suspenseful episodes. The new chapters of Gandii Baat 6 subtly unravel the stories revolving around murder mysteries, thrillers, and psychopaths. So, are you ready to witness the spine-chilling twists & fascinating storylines that Gandii Baat Season 6 will bring to the table?

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Bringing back to you the thrills of sleepless nights with new fantasies of Gandii Baat Season 7 which is an all-new collection of stories. This season highlights different preferences of people in terms of sexual partners, but also the crazy places where they choose to get down, hot & steamy. This time, women are willing to explore and embrace their darkest desires, they get deeply involved in unspeakable dirty deeds.
